moved.sentence: Deliberate and prudent only: "ship the simple version now, revisit when X happens" is fine when it's written down; an undocumented shortcut nobody chose is reckless debt.

judged.note: must-take-debt-only-deliberately-and-prudently makes 'deliberate and prudent only' a MUST and keeps the written-down example and the reckless-debt definition of an unchosen, undocumented shortcut.

moved.sentence: Record it at the point of compromise: leave a tracked marker (debt register, issue, or a TODO that states the condition) naming the trigger that should prompt repayment.

judged.note: should-record-debt-at-point-of-compromise restates the sentence at SHOULD, keeping recording at the point of compromise, all three marker kinds including a TODO that states the condition, and the named repayment trigger.

moved.sentence: Budget repayment: allocate capacity each iteration to pay debt down; debt with no payback plan compounds into decay.

judged.note: should-budget-repayment-each-iteration keeps allocating capacity each iteration to pay debt down and the reason that unplanned debt compounds into decay.

moved.sentence: Account for AI volume: agent-generated code can inflate duplication and churn faster than debt is repaid — size debt budgets against the volume produced, and prefer paying down before adding more.

judged.note: should-size-debt-budgets-against-ai-volume keeps the AI-volume reason and both instructions: size budgets against volume produced, and prefer paying down before adding more.
